name: @auths-dev/sdk
description: Prove exact authority, execute protected actions, and leave signed receipts

scripts.test:all: npm run test:contract && npm run test:integration && npm run test:unit && npm run test:package && npm run test:examples && npm run test:api && npm run test:capability && npm run test:runtime-contract
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:vectors && node tools/run-tests.mjs integration
scripts.test:integration:built: npm run build && node tools/run-tests.mjs integration
scripts.test:package: npm run build && node tools/run-tests.mjs package
scripts.test:packed: npm run test:package && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:sealed: npm run build && node --test test/integration/verifier.test.js test/integration/diagnostic.test.js test/integration/non-forgeability.test.js test/integration/inspection.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node tools/run-tests.mjs unit
